The '''Cryo-nesters''', also known as '''Cryotenders''',<ref name="Glacial">{{TORcite|type=location|[[Glacial Trespass]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> were massive, armored [[Insect/Legends|insectoids]]<ref name="codexSha" /> known to aerate frozen soil and spread frost flora seeds.<ref name="FrigidSwarm">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Frigid Swarm|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Similarly to a perhaps relative species of [[Shaclaw|shaclaw]]<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>, cryo-nesters had powerful foreclaws able to tear through the flesh and armor of their foes as well as burrow into the earth in search of food.<ref name="codexSha" /> Due to visual similarities, cryo-nesters were sometimes referred to as "Obsidian shaclaws".<ref name="obsidian">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Pet "Obsidian Shaclaw"}}</ref>

==Biology and appearance==
[[File:CryonesterEgg-SWTOR.png|left|thumb|200px|Eggs of a cryo-nester]]
Cryo-nesters were born from eggs<ref name="Frigid Swarm">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Frigid Swarm|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> and started their lives as small [[Larva/Legends|larvae]].<ref name="cryonestMatron">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|The Cryonest Matron|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref> Their adult size could vary quite significantly.<ref name="Glacial" /> Insects had a number of castes performing different roles, as such, ''broodguards'' defended oviposition sites,<ref name="FrigidSwarm" /> while ''frostkeepers'' were the group most responsible for extensive areal refrigeration associated with cryo-nesters' population.<ref name="Frostcaller">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Frostcaller|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==History==
While the ship's incubators were producing more cryo-nesters,<ref name="cryonestMatron" /> [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors were trying to control their population to stop the cataclysmic fall of temperature in the region.<ref name="Glacial" />

Cryo-nesters significantly affected the climate of their habitat, however they were dependent on other thermal-dampening life as well. [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maniks]], who took an especial interest in the insects, observed a symbiotic relationship between cryo-nesters and [[Frostbloom|frostblooms]], plant-based life with similar freezing characteristics. Cryo-nesters spread the seeds of frostblooms and defended the plant from GSI contractors, becoming substantially more aggressive as the frostblooms got burned by scientists' efforts.<ref name="FrigidSwarm" /> This resulted in several occasions of swarming cryo-nesters attacking the [[Glacial Trespass]] forward scientific camp, nearly destroying the [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]]'s research.<ref name="outpostDefense">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=dynamic|Outpost Defense|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Introduced in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', cryo-nesters use a retextured 3D model of [[shaclaw]]s. However even if related, the two species are presented as undoubtedly different.<ref name="TOR" />
